Hello again! I'd love a drawing of this character. I'm fine with any cute/pose and expression! 

She has blue sparkly eyes. Her hair is pastel pink with pastel blue highlights! She has blue flowers in her hair. She has a big rabbit tail! She also has fangs. Her rabbit ears have stars in them! She has very pale skin, she is petite, small and cute and doll-like! She has a small chest size. She has a cute, elegant and princess-like personality.

If you want, Feel free to design an outfit for her (optional)! I like frilly, doll-like clothes with a lot of ribbons and short skirts! 

(please scroll down in the link below for more images and references!)  

Thank you for considering my request!

https://imgur.com/a/WESbeiy
